---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem does this solve? Who hits it? How often?

## Proposed solution

Describe the change you'd like to see. Be concrete — APIs, CLI flags,
config keys, file paths, behaviour.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you rejected them.

## Scope

- [ ] Free tier (knowledge/code graph, hooks, bundled agents/skills)
- [ ] Paid module (RL retrieval, multi-agent maestro, specialist agents)
- [ ] Launcher / installer
- [ ] Documentation only

## Additional context

Links to similar features in other tools, related issues, prior discussion.
